An Italian baby raised by Japanese parents still talked with his hands.

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of two Italians who moved to Japan, had a baby, and died in a car crash a week later. The baby was adopted and grew up in a purely Japanese home.

Every other child spoke one way at school. The Italian boy, who only spoke Japanese, still used his hands. Kevin's point is that it was in his DNA.

How much of how you behave do you think you were born with?
